This aligns with the market-implied probabilities favoring those two outcomes at roughly two-thirds combined. Early June observations already show daytime highs running 2–4 °C below the 1991–2020 climatological average of 21–22 °C, consistent with a stronger-than-normal westerly flow and Atlantic influence. Forecasters note modest uncertainty in exact cloud timing and any brief clearing that could allow a 20 °C reading, while probabilities for 21 °C or higher remain low absent a rapid shift in steering patterns before the date. Updated high-resolution runs and official bulletins in the next 48 hours will provide the clearest guidance ahead of market resolution.
